pairs.subject: knowledge-registry
pairs.evidence: src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:259 The catalog itself is a proper sync key (envelope, normalized sha256-n1 digest, one shared digest function), but nothing compares fleet copies against it: the live view sends hard zeros for all four adoption states, so the consumer-facing in-sync/stale/diverged/local-only answer is never produced, and 'unmeasured' is carried as zeros that the UI has to infer from an all-zero sum (absence encoded as a value).

techniques.evidence: src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:114 Catalog side conforms (src/lib/registry/catalog.ts: envelope, normalized digest, single contentDigest function), but the four-state report the technique requires is never computed, and absence travels as zero rather than as an absent field.
src/app/api/org/[slug]/registry/migrate/route.ts:2 Migration stops at a draft PR. Merging (a CODEOWNER act) is the adoption step, and ascent never merges.

src/app/api/org/[slug]/registry/migrate/route.ts:9 Existing content moves one artifact kind per proposal, each on a stable branch (src/lib/registry/migrate.ts). The scaffold (src/lib/registry/scaffold.ts, outside this context) also handles the spine collision and later-file collisions as two separate cases.
src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:332 The usage/ lane's contributor count is published beside invokes30d, so 'nobody reporting' and 'nobody using' are kept apart.

src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:351 The signals lane is read per subject with a contributor count. summarizeSignals (src/lib/registry/signals.ts) sums all three citation verdicts (resolved/moved/gone) and leaves unreported keys null, and signals-contribution.ts emits them, so the channel is not half-consumed.

src/lib/registry/catalog.ts:110 The catalog write the index route triggers carries forward keys owned by the registry's second producer (bundles, usage-derived invokes) instead of rebuilding from scratch. Anchor is outside the listed files, in the module the index pass writes with.
